subject.title: [Bug]: Web UI chat images display too large

question: Should maintainers adopt or replace the open fork PR that applies the sidebar image sizing parity fix for this issue?
rationale: The source-visible fix is narrow, but the linked branch is an external fork with maintainerCanModify false and still needs maintainer handling before the issue can close.

options.title: Adopt or replace the CSS parity fix
options.body: Create or land a maintainer-controlled version of the two-line sidebar image sizing change with browser proof.

options.title: Wait for contributor update
options.body: Keep the issue open while asking the fork PR author for fresh proof and an updated branch.

options.title: Reject the parity fix
options.body: Leave the issue open only if maintainers decide the oversized image symptom needs a different proven root-cause fix.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace the CSS parity fix
recommendation.body: Create or land a maintainer-controlled version of the two-line sidebar image sizing change with browser proof.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev authored the current UI image sizing rules and is the clearest routing candidate for deciding whether parity is the right fix.
